title: Probability of a Unique FF3-Scale Cycle
summary: Prior cycle-length results support assuming that a unique cycle exists at the FF3 attack scale, but the event’s probability and asymptotic behavior remain unresolved.

formal_statement.body: $\Pr[\exists!$ a cycle of length approximately $\widetilde{O}(N^{3/2})$ in a random permutation on $N^2$ points$]$, and its asymptotic behavior.

scope.domain: Probabilistic combinatorics of permutation cycles relevant to the FF3 cycle-structure attack.
assumptions: The probability is taken over a random permutation on N squared points.
parameters: N: sets the permutation domain to N squared points and the target cycle length to approximately O-tilde of N to the three-halves
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the probability that exactly one target-scale cycle exists and characterize the probability's asymptotic behavior.

citations.label: Three Third Generation Attacks on the Format Preserving Encryption Scheme FF3

progress.summary: The paper invokes prior cycle-length results to present existence and uniqueness at the relevant FF3 attack scale as reasonable assumptions motivating the cycle-structure attack.
citation_labels: Ohad Amon et al., Three Third Generation Attacks on the Format Preserving Encryption Scheme FF3
